derived_cause: Three mandatory Bet Replay checklist items are implemented ONLY as three inline `isReplay` guards in App.svelte, and the replay verification suite is scoped to the wrong file, so nothing asserts them. SPEC (l.1): docs/stake-engine-live/game-replay-requirements.md:128 'Disable betting UI - Hide or disable all bet controls', :129 'Disable session calls - Do not make any authenticated API calls', :134 'Prevent session transition - No way to start normal play from replay'. The sole implementation of each is, respectively, App.svelte's `{#if isReplay} <ReplayMode /> {:else}` swap (HEAD 1697-1700; 1689-1692 at the observation epoch), the `if (isReplay) return` placed ahead of `await initRGS(...)` in onMount (HEAD 1177-1178 / epoch 1169-1170), and the `if (isReplay) return` at the top of handleKeydown (HEAD 1605-1606 / epoch 1597-1598). MECHANISM OF THE GAP, in four steps. (1) At the observation epoch (tree eb357d9, 2026-07-28, where the cited line numbers resolve exactly) checks.yml carried exactly one replay step, `replay rounds` (eb357d9:.github/workflows/checks.yml:420-422), and its ten-leg browser matrix (:571-599) contained no leg that loads a replay URL, so nothing ran the app in replay mode at all. (2) That one step's SCOPE was set by the defect that created it, not by the requirement: its own header (:412-419, current :637-644) says it exists for TR-040, ReplayMode.svelte's legacy board/win/scatter search. (3) It is a node/tsx script, and by its own statement `a .svelte file's script block cannot be imported by tsx` (replayRounds.test.ts:20-25), so every component-level claim it can make is a regex SOURCE SCAN, and that scan reads exactly one hardcoded file, `src/lib/components/ReplayMode.svelte` (replayRounds.test.ts:154), asserting only the absence of the legacy event search and the single interpreter call (:155-162). App.svelte is never opened by it. (4) ReplayMode.svelte is a leaf: it cannot mount itself, cannot suppress the live-play chrome, and cannot disarm the keyboard. Everything the requirement actually asks for is decided one level up, in the file the gate does not read. Compounding this, all three properties are ABSENCE properties (no bet controls rendered, no authenticated call issued, no spin on Space); an absence is observable only by running the built bundle in replay mode and looking, which is precisely what no wired step did. An existing script does drive the production build at the live replay parameter shape, frontend/scripts/replay_blocker_proof.mjs:11-14, but it was never a CI step and its assertions are backdrop hit-testing and win presentation, not suppression. Net effect: deleting or inverting any of the three guards left every CI leg green. RESIDUE AT HEAD: replay_contract_gate.mjs was added 2026-07-29 (db4247b) and wired at checks.yml:899-900; it closes item :129 only, via `no authenticated RGS call in replay` (replay_contract_gate.mjs:369-372, AUTHED_ROUTE :134). It never queries for bet controls, balance, autoplay or theme selector and never presses a key, so items :128 and :134 are still held by unasserted App.svelte guards.
